blocks.en: This page describes in simple terms the equipment and techniques used to probe down exploration sites. For more details on the exact mechanics of probing, see probe scanning.
blocks.zh: 本页用简单的语言介绍用探针扫出探索站点所需的装备和技巧。关于探针扫描的具体机制，详见探针扫描。

blocks.en: Preparation
blocks.zh: 准备工作

blocks.en: Sensible preparation in character training and equipment makes probing much easier.
blocks.zh: 在角色技能和装备上做好合理的准备，会让扫描轻松很多。

blocks.en: Skills
blocks.zh: 技能

blocks.en: Scanning skills
blocks.zh: 扫描技能

en: Astrometrics: useful bonuses to scan strength(+5%), scan deviation(-5%) and scan time(-5%) per level. Level I unlocks the Core Probe Launchers and Core Scanner Probes, level II unlocks the Expanded Probe Launchers and the Combat Scanner Probes. Level IV is the prerequisite for Astrometric Pinpointing and should be a short-term priority for the aspiring explorer.
Astrometric Pinpointing: 5% reduction in maximum scan deviation per level.

This skill is especially useful in the early phases of probing and makes life easier. Training high levels of this skill paired with high signal strength will allow you to reduce the scanning radius more aggressively. Levels II and V allow use of Tech 1 and Tech 2 scan pinpointing arrays respectively.

Astrometric Rangefinding: 5% increase in scan probe strength per level, making it the most important of these skills. Levels II and V allow use of Tech 1 and Tech 2 scan rangefinding arrays respectively.

Astrometric Acquisition: 5% reduction in scan time per level. This skill is useful for combat scanning, when every second counts, but is not hugely important otherwise. Levels II and V allow use of Tech 1 and Tech 2 scan acquisition arrays respectively.
zh: 太空测量学（Astrometrics）：每级提供实用的加成——扫描强度 +5%、扫描偏差 -5%、扫描时间 -5%。I 级解锁核心探针发射器和核心扫描探针，II 级解锁延伸探针发射器和作战扫描探针。IV 级是定点测量学的前置技能，有志于探索的新人应该尽快练到。
定点测量学（Astrometric Pinpointing）：每级降低 5% 最大扫描偏差。
这个技能在扫描的初期阶段特别有用，能让你轻松不少。把它练到高等级，再配合较高的信号强度，你就可以更激进地缩小扫描半径。II 级和 V 级分别允许使用 T1 和 T2 扫描定位阵列。
天文测距学（Astrometric Rangefinding）：每级提高 5% 扫描探针强度，是这几个技能中最重要的一个。II 级和 V 级分别允许使用 T1 和 T2 扫描测距阵列。
天文探测学（Astrometric Acquisition）：每级减少 5% 扫描时间。这个技能在争分夺秒的作战扫描中很有用，其它情况下就不太重要。II 级和 V 级分别允许使用 T1 和 T2 扫描精准阵列。

blocks.en: Other skills
blocks.zh: 其它技能

en: Racial Frigate: Level I is required for the Tech 1 scanning frigate of each faction (Magnate, Heron, Imicus and Probe) and the strong per-level bonus for scanner probe strength on these hulls make training it to IV worthwhile. Level V is a step towards covert ops ships.

Covert Ops: together with racial frigate V, this skill unlocks the covert ops ships (Anathema, Buzzard, Helios and Cheetah). New players need not rush into these, but covert ops ships are a good medium-term goal for keen explorers.
Note that since the hull bonuses for scanner probe strength on the covert ops ships are per-level, a covert ops ship only outmatches a Tech 1 exploration frigate in probe strength at Covert Ops IV.

Cloaking: level I is needed to use prototype cloaks, handy for Tech 1 exploration frigates; IV is necessary to fit covert ops cloaks and should be trained when a character is on their way to flying covert ops ships.
High Speed Maneuvering: to fit MWD.
Archaeology: level III is a quick train and makes you useful, IV is a good short-term goal for dedicated explorers, V is needed to use the Tech 2 relic analyzer.
Hacking: level III is a quick train and makes you useful, IV is a good short-term goal for dedicated explorers V is needed to use the Tech 2 data analyzer.
zh: 各族护卫舰操作：驾驶各势力的 T1 扫描护卫舰（富豪级、苍鹭级、伊米卡斯级和探索级）需要 I 级，而这些船体每级都有很强的扫描探针强度加成，因此值得练到 IV 级。V 级则是通往隐形特勤舰的一步。
隐形特勤舰操作（Covert Ops）：配合各族护卫舰操作 V 级，这个技能可以解锁隐形特勤舰（咒逐级、秃鹰级、太阳神级和猎豹级）。新手不必急着上手，但对热衷探索的玩家来说，隐形特勤舰是一个不错的中期目标。
注意，由于隐形特勤舰的扫描探针强度船体加成是按技能等级计算的，隐形特勤舰操作要到 IV 级，隐形特勤舰的探针强度才会超过 T1 探索护卫舰。
隐形理论（Cloaking）：I 级可以使用尖端型隐形装置，适合 T1 探索护卫舰；IV 级才能装配隐秘行动隐形装置，准备驾驶隐形特勤舰的角色应该练到这一级。
高速机动理论（High Speed Maneuvering）：用于装配微型跃迁推进器（MWD）。
考古学（Archaeology）：III 级练得很快，练完就能派上用场；IV 级是专职探索者不错的短期目标；V 级才能使用 T2 遗迹分析仪。
电脑破译原理（Hacking）：III 级练得很快，练完就能派上用场；IV 级是专职探索者不错的短期目标；V 级才能使用 T2 数据分析仪。

blocks.en: Equipment
blocks.zh: 装备

blocks.en: Any ship can be used for exploration, but the Tech 1 frigates mentioned above offer a bonus, and ultimately a Tech 2 covert ops frigate is optimal.
blocks.zh: 任何舰船都可以用来探索，但上面提到的 T1 护卫舰有加成，而最终最理想的是 T2 隐形特勤舰。

blocks.en: The first and most important pieces of equipment you need for scanning are a probe launcher and probes. The normal Core Probe Launcher I and Core Scanner Probe I are acceptable starting-points for scanning signatures. Later these can be upgraded to the Tech 2 or Sisters core probe launchers, and Sisters core scanner probes. Sisters probes are a relatively cheap way to improve your effectiveness in scanning.
blocks.zh: 扫描最先需要、也是最重要的装备是探针发射器和探针。普通的核心探针发射器 I 和核心扫描探针 I 足以作为扫描宇宙信号的起点。之后可以升级到 T2 或姐妹会核心探针发射器，以及姐妹会核心扫描探针。姐妹会探针是提升扫描效率的一种相对便宜的方式。

blocks.en: For scanning structures, ships, and drones, pilots need an Expanded Probe Launcher and combat scanner probes. Combat scan probes can also, technically, scan signatures, but they aren't as good for this use as core probes. Expanded probe launchers can use both core and combat probes, but are much harder to fit than core probe launchers.
blocks.zh: 要扫描建筑、舰船和无人机，需要延伸探针发射器和作战扫描探针。严格来说，作战扫描探针也能扫宇宙信号，但效果不如核心探针。延伸探针发射器可以同时使用核心探针和作战探针，但比核心探针发射器难装配得多。

blocks.en: The probe launcher and probes are the only mandatory equipment. Other useful equipment should be chosen to fit the job you want to do:
blocks.zh: 探针发射器和探针是唯一必需的装备。其它有用的装备应根据你要做的事来选择：

en: Scan arrays in the mid slots and Gravity Capacitor Upgrade rigs in the rig slots increase your probe stats, making scanning easier.
If you are scanning for relic and data sites, relic and data analyzers are necessary to do the sites once you've found them.
A prototype cloak lets even a Tech I frigate hide safely while scanning. A covert ops cloak on a covert ops ship lets the ship warp around while cloaked.
A cloak combined with a microwarp drive lets you perform the "cloak trick", increasing your survivability in hostile space.

Virtue pirate implants increase scan probe strength. Poteque "Prospector" implants decrease scan deviation, scan time or increase probe strength depending on which variant is used. Balance the benefits of using these against the potential cost of losing them if you are operating in nullsec, or wormhole space.
In a ship's low slots, you can also fit either nanofibers for speed and agility, inertial stabilizers for agility or warp core stabilizers for running away.
zh: 中槽的扫描阵列和改装件槽的引力电容器升级改装件可以提升探针属性，让扫描更容易。
如果你要扫遗迹和数据站点，找到站点后需要遗迹分析仪和数据分析仪才能完成。
尖端型隐形装置能让即使是 T1 护卫舰也可以在扫描时安全隐藏。隐形特勤舰装上隐秘行动隐形装置后，可以在隐形状态下跃迁。
隐形装置配合微型跃迁推进器可以实现“隐形技巧”（cloak trick），提高在敌对空间中的生存能力。
美德（Virtue）海盗植入体可以提高扫描探针强度。波特克“掘金者”（Poteque 'Prospector'）植入体根据型号不同，可以降低扫描偏差、缩短扫描时间或提高探针强度。如果你在 00 区或虫洞空间活动，要权衡使用它们的好处和损失它们的潜在代价。
在舰船的低槽，还可以装纳米纤维内部构架提升速度和灵活度，装惯性稳定器提升灵活度，或装跃迁稳定器用于逃跑。

blocks.en: For gas sites a gas cloud harvester is required and for combat sites you need to fit your ship with combat equipment. Unless you are using a strategic cruiser, you might want to reship for both of these types of site.
blocks.zh: 气云站点需要气云采集器，战斗站点则需要给舰船装上战斗装备。除非你用的是战略巡洋舰，否则做这两类站点时可能都需要换船。

blocks.en: Probing
blocks.zh: 扫描

blocks.en: Probe scanner window with labels.
blocks.zh: 带标注的探针扫描器窗口。

blocks.en: Launching probes
blocks.zh: 发射探针

blocks.en: To start probing launch your probes and open both the system map and probe scanner window.
blocks.zh: 开始扫描时，先发射探针，然后同时打开星系地图和探针扫描器窗口。

blocks.en: Many players find it useful to undock the probe scanner window from the system map by clicking the square icon on the top right corner of the probe scanner window. This allows you to open and close both the system map and the probe scanner independently.
blocks.zh: 很多玩家习惯点击探针扫描器窗口右上角的方形图标，把它从星系地图中分离出来。这样就可以分别打开和关闭星系地图和探针扫描器。

blocks.en: With the probe scanner open, the system map now shows information relevant for probing. The red spheres are signatures that need to be probed with probes, green icons are anomalies or completely probed signatures, and the blue spheres are the areas scanned by each of your probes.
blocks.zh: 打开探针扫描器后，星系地图会显示与扫描相关的信息。红色球体是需要用探针扫描的信号，绿色图标是异常或已完全扫出的信号，蓝色球体是你每个探针的扫描范围。

blocks.en: Initial placement
blocks.zh: 初始布置

blocks.en: You have several controls for your probes.
blocks.zh: 你可以通过以下几种方式控制探针。

en: Drag the cube to move the whole probe formation.
Hold shift to move individual probes.
Hold control to adjust probe distance from center point.
Alt+scroll, alt+drag or slider in probe scanner window to alter probe range
assignable keyboard shortcuts for this are available in Escape → Shortcuts → Combat
Decrease Probe Scan Range & Increase Probe Scan Range
zh: 拖动立方体可以移动整个探针阵型。
按住 Shift 可以单独移动某个探针。
按住 Ctrl 可以调整探针与中心点的距离。
按住 Alt 滚动滚轮、按住 Alt 拖动，或使用探针扫描器窗口中的滑块，可以改变探针范围
可以在 Esc → 快捷键（Shortcuts）→ 战斗（Combat）中为此设置键盘快捷键
减小探针扫描范围 & 增大探针扫描范围

blocks.en: You can also move your probes to pinpoint formation, spread formation or your own saved custom formation in the probe scanner window. When scanning signatures, only pinpoint formation, formation move, and probe range changes are needed. Sometimes you may encounter a signature you can't get all the way to 100%. You can try moving your probes into a more tightly packed pinpoint formation to get 0.1% more signal, but placing them too close to each other will reduce scan results.
blocks.zh: 你还可以在探针扫描器窗口中把探针切换为定点阵型（pinpoint）、分散阵型（spread）或你自己保存的自定义阵型。扫描宇宙信号时，只需要用到定点阵型、移动阵型和调整探针范围。有时你可能会遇到怎么也扫不到 100% 的信号。可以试着把探针排成更紧凑的定点阵型，多拿到 0.1% 的信号，但探针彼此靠得太近反而会降低扫描结果。

blocks.en: To scan a signature, move your probe formation over the signature sphere. A good starting formation is the pinpoint formation, with range adjusted to cover the whole signature sphere. A trick to help with initial probe placement is to know that all signatures are within 4 AU from celestial objects. If there is only one celestial near the signature sphere, then the signature is near it and you can place your probes there.
blocks.zh: 要扫描某个信号，把探针阵型移到该信号的球体上。定点阵型是不错的初始阵型，把范围调整到能覆盖整个信号球体即可。初始布置有一个小技巧：所有信号都在天体 4 AU 范围之内。如果信号球体附近只有一个天体，那么信号就在它附近，可以把探针放在那里。

blocks.en: Now refresh probe scan by clicking the "Analyze" button in the probe scanner window. Depending on your probe placement and probe stats, the marker of the signature will change, and you can then begin to narrow the signature down.
blocks.zh: 然后点击探针扫描器窗口中的“分析”（Analyze）按钮刷新扫描。根据探针的位置和属性，信号的标记会发生变化，接下来就可以开始逐步缩小范围。

blocks.en: Refining the scan
blocks.zh: 细化扫描

blocks.en: When the signature is seen as a sphere place the pinpoint formation to cover the whole sphere.
blocks.zh: 当信号显示为球体时，用定点阵型覆盖整个球体。

blocks.en: The signature is always withing 4 AU from a celestial. If there is only one celestial in the area you can move your 4 AU pinpoint formation to cover only space near it.
blocks.zh: 信号一定在某个天体 4 AU 范围之内。如果该区域只有一个天体，可以把 4 AU 的定点阵型移过去，只覆盖它附近的空间。

blocks.en: When the signature is seen as a circle there is no good simple trick. Move the probes to cover the whole circle but closer to one of its sides.
blocks.zh: 当信号显示为圆环时，没有什么简单好用的技巧。移动探针覆盖整个圆环，但要更靠近其中一侧。

blocks.en: When the signature is seen as two points the point that is further away from your previous scan point is most likely the signature location.
blocks.zh: 当信号显示为两个点时，离上一次扫描位置较远的那个点最有可能是信号所在位置。

blocks.en: When the signature is seen as single point move probe formation on it and decrease probe size.
blocks.zh: 当信号显示为单个点时，把探针阵型移到该点上并缩小探针范围。

blocks.en: A number of different results can occur after an initial scan.
blocks.zh: 初次扫描后可能出现几种不同的结果。

en: If only one probe overlapped with the signature, the result is a sphere. You know that the signature is inside that sphere in the region that overlaps with one probe only. Center your probe formation on the new sphere, adjust range, and scan again.

If two probes overlapped with the signature, the result is a circle. The signature is somewhere on the circle where only two probes overlap with each other. Make an educated guess, move your formation, resize and scan again.

If three probes overlapped with the signature, the result is two points connected by a line. The signature is near one of the points. Usually, it is on the point that is further away from your probe formation's center. Move your probes, adjust range, and scan again.

If four or more probes overlapped with the signature the result is one point. Center your formation on it, reduce probe range and scan again. At this point, and assuming your probe strength is sufficiently strong to scan the signature at all, you will probably be able to pinpoint the signature just by repeatedly re-centering the formation and reducing its range.
zh: 如果只有一个探针覆盖到信号，结果显示为球体。信号就在这个球体内、只被一个探针覆盖的区域中。把探针阵型移到新球体的中心，调整范围后再扫一次。
如果有两个探针覆盖到信号，结果显示为圆环。信号位于圆环上只有两个探针相互重叠的某处。根据经验判断一下，移动阵型、调整大小后再扫。
如果有三个探针覆盖到信号，结果显示为一条线连接的两个点。信号在其中一个点附近，通常是离探针阵型中心较远的那个点。移动探针、调整范围后再扫。
如果有四个或更多探针覆盖到信号，结果显示为一个点。把阵型移到该点中心，缩小探针范围后再扫。到了这一步，只要你的探针强度足够扫到这个信号，通常只需反复把阵型对准中心并缩小范围，就能精确定位信号。

blocks.en: Repeat the above steps until the signature is scanned and you can warp to it.
blocks.zh: 重复以上步骤，直到信号被扫出、可以跃迁过去为止。
